reason: With 8 staff I honestly don't know if the cash in the drawer matches the bills or if someone is doing customers off the book, and ₹999 a month is nothing next to that leak. The first month is free, so I'd try it, though the ₹4,999 setup only feels fair if they actually train my people in the salon.
objection: My stylists are busy with customers and they won't type every walk-in into an app. If they skip it on a busy Saturday, the numbers are useless and I've paid for nothing.
would_change_my_mind: If after two weeks my staff are still billing on WhatsApp and paper instead of the app, I'd stop before paying the monthly fee.
